create_CLIPLoss: create a CLIPLoss module to compute contrastive image-text loss with multi-GPU support
create_SIMCLRLoss: create a SIMCLRLoss module to compute self-supervised contrastive loss with configurable temperature
create_SLIPLoss: create a SLIPLoss module combining CLIPLoss and SSL loss with a configurable scale factor
test_CLIPLoss_forward: test the CLIPLoss forward method with image and text embeddings and logit scale
test_SIMCLRLoss_forward: test the SIMCLRLoss forward method with augmented embedding pairs and temperature
